label: Bayesian tracking
methodsText: {popsToTrack} cells were tracked with btrack (maximum search radius {maxSearchRadius}, gaps of up to {maxLost} frames, tracks of at least {minTimepoints} timepoints).
purpose: Link segmented cells across frames into tracks
useWhen: Time-lapse with cells segmented on every frame
Track only gated populations, e.g. with debris gated out, each on its own
notWhen: Tracks without speed or angle: use Bayesian track + measures
Whole field moves together: run Drift correction first
Few or broken tracks: check segmentation finds each cell every frame

params.label: Segmentation
params.tip: The segmentation (label set) whose cells to track

params.label: Populations
params.tip: Each tracked on its own; none picked tracks the whole segmentation

params.label: Max search radius (µm)
params.tip: Furthest a cell may move per frame, so scale it with the frame interval

params.label: Allowed gaps (linking)
params.tip: Frames a track may be unobserved while being built; joins use Time threshold

params.label: Track branching
params.tip: Allow cell division / branching hypotheses

params.label: Minimum timepoints
params.tip: Remove tracks shorter than this many timepoints

params.label: Accuracy
params.tip: Motion-model accuracy (scaled internally)

params.label: Prob. to assign track
params.tip: Probability of assigning a detection to an existing track

params.label: Initial noise
params.tip: Multiplier for the motion model initial covariance (P)

params.label: Processing noise
params.tip: Multiplier for the motion model process noise (G)

params.label: Measurement noise
params.tip: Multiplier for the motion model measurement noise (R)

params.label: Distance threshold (µm)
params.tip: Furthest apart two track ends may be joined (1 µm or more)

params.label: Time threshold
params.tip: Frames apart two track ends may be joined — this is what gaps end up being

params.label: Segmentation miss rate
params.tip: Prior probability that a cell is undetected in a frame

params.label: Lambda link
params.tip: Hypothesis-model link-events rate

params.label: Lambda branch
params.tip: Hypothesis-model branching-events rate

params.label: Lambda time
params.tip: Hypothesis-model time factor

params.label: Lambda dist
params.tip: Hypothesis-model distance factor

params.label: Theta time
params.tip: Hypothesis-model time threshold

params.label: Theta dist (µm)
params.tip: Distance at which a join becomes unlikely; shapes the score, not a limit
